warnings: TRANSCRIPTION RECONCILIATION -- every prior per-page extraction (A-08 view1's own warning, A-09/A-10's รูปด้าน1-4, A-11's รูปตัด1-2) transcribed the cubicle-elevation chain's two outer segments as '1.55 m'. Summed with the rest of the printed row (1.55+1.00+1.00+1.00+0.10+1.00+1.00+1.00+1.55=9.20) this does NOT match the grid-confirmed ก-to-ค distance of 9.00 m (a 0.20 m / 200 mm discrepancy -- too large for rounding). Substituting 1.45 m for both outer segments reconciles EXACTLY (1.45+1.00+1.00+1.00+0.10+1.00+1.00+1.00+1.45=9.00) AND centres the 0.10 m central wall exactly on named ข (4.45 to 4.55, midpoint 4.50). This sweep adopts 1.45 m as the reconciled value for @1.45/@2.45/@3.45/@4.45/@4.55/@5.55/@6.55/@7.55. This is a judgement call, not a re-read of the original scan at higher resolution -- a human should verify the printed digit against the actual A-09/A-10 drawing (4 vs 5 is a plausible OCR/transcription slip) before this is applied.

NAME COLLISION WARNING FOR gridfix.py -- the สุขา master ALREADY has two dummy y-lines named ข' and ค' (both pos_m: null, added by a prior beam-endpoint-rule pass for the horizontal B5 beam's mid-span position, 'visually ~2.25m' per their notes). This sweep's newly-derived points (@1.45/@2.45/@3.45/@4.45 in the ก-ข gap and @4.55/@5.55/@6.55/@7.55 in the ข-ค gap) are DIFFERENT physical points from the existing ข'/ค' -- the existing ones describe a STRUCTURAL beam position (S-02/beam plan), while the new ones describe ARCHITECTURAL partition-wall positions (A-08/A-09/A-10/A-11) -- they are not expected to coincide and none of the new points is within 0.05m of 2.25 (the existing dummy's rough visual estimate). When gridfix.py assigns final prime names, it will need to interleave the existing (structurally-sourced) ข'/ค' into the same ก-ข and ข-ค prime sequences as these new (architecturally-sourced) points once the existing dummy's true pos_m is resolved -- this sweep does NOT attempt to resolve the existing ข'/ค' position, that is outside rule-4's additive scope.

RULE-4 DECISION -- as on the main-building master, the '0.10' (wall face) and '0.60' (roof eave) offsets beyond grid1/grid2 and beyond ก/ค are treated as TWO INDEPENDENT dimensions measured from the same grid/wall line (not nested/additive), consistent with every sheet's own printed values (e.g. A-08 roof plan prints a clean standalone '0.60/4.50/4.50/0.60' with no 0.10 sub-tick).

Every new point in this sweep is corroborated by at least 2 independent sheets (the x-axis interior points @1.40/@4.60 by 4 sheets: A-08 floor+roof, A-09 รูปด้าน1, A-10 รูปด้าน3, A-11 รูปตัด2; the y-axis interior points by 4 sheets: A-09 รูปด้าน2, A-10 รูปด้าน4, A-11 รูปตัด1, plus A-08's partial floor-plan read) except the outer wall/eave edges (@-0.10/@6.10/@-0.60/@6.60 x-axis; @9.10/@-0.10/@9.60/@-0.60 y-axis), each confirmed on at least 3 sheets.

S-02 inset (หน้า15_view2, beam plan) and S-03 inset (หน้า16_view2, roof frame plan) were NOT re-swept for x/y dimension chains here -- their own element-level warnings (already in the existing file) record the ข'/ค' dummy-grid discovery and B4/B5/B6/T2/D/E/F member positions in full, and re-reading their images added no new printed dimension beyond what those existing per-page files already transcribe. Only the pages actually contributing new chain data (A-08/A-09/A-10/A-11/S-01 inset/E-02 inset/SN-01 x2) were directly re-read for this sweep; the rest of pages_swept relied on their own already-detailed per-page warnings, cross-checked for internal consistency rather than re-imaged pixel-by-pixel.
